title: Open Values Value Editorial v0.4
description: The sourced explanations shown on each value's page, such as Organic or Repairability: what the value requires, who checks it, where it stops and how the site uses it in scores. Conscious Consuming keeps it.

format.description: Always "open-values-value-editorial". Tells a reader that this file holds the explanations shown on value pages.

version.description: The version of this file's format, 0.4.0.

updated.description: The day the file was last changed, as YYYY-MM-DD.

state.description: Which batch of writing the file holds. Always "environmental-durability-batch" in this version.

purpose.description: One or two sentences saying what the file is for.

renderRule.description: The rule the app follows when showing entries: which entries may be shown, and what to show for a value that has none.

requiredValues.description: The keys of the fifteen values that have a page in the app, in the app's order. Every one must have an entry.

pilotValues.description: The keys of the five values that were written first. They must stay in entries.

entries.description: One explanation for each value, keyed by the value's key, such as "organic".

text.description: The claim itself, as shown on the page, in 40 to 520 characters.

sourceLabel.description: The name of the source as shown on the page, such as the publisher and page title.

source.description: The web address of the source, starting with https://.

asOf.description: The day the source was checked for this claim, as YYYY-MM-DD.

id.description: Which part of the explanation this is: "requires" (what the value or label requires), "evidence" (what is looked for), "checked-by" (who checks it), "limits" (where it stops) or "scoring" (how the site reads it in scores).

heading.description: The section heading as shown on the page, such as "Who checks it".

claims.description: One or two sourced claims that make up the section.

key.description: The value's key, the same as the entry's key in entries.

label.description: The value's name as shown to people, such as "Organic".

kind.description: "certified" when the value rests on a label or certification, "assessed" when it rests on researched judgement.

classification.description: What sort of evidence stands behind the value: a certification scheme, an assessed value, a family of labels, an ingredient analysis, or a mix of methods.

status.description: Always "ready-for-founder-review" in this version. The app shows only entries with this status.

summary.description: Two or three sentences, 80 to 300 characters, saying what the value tells a reader and what it does not.

sections.description: The four parts of the explanation, each with a heading and sourced claims.
